hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '/backend/.*\.php$' && (cd backend && vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent) || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '/frontend/.*\.(ts|tsx|css)$' && (cd frontend && npx prettier --write "$f") || true
jq -r '.prompt' | grep -qiE 'rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard' && { echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected. Please confirm you want to proceed.' >&2; exit 1; } || exit 0
